name: kin-ai
description: Kin's AI model provider — local models via Ollama.

kin.ollama.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the Ollama server providing Kin's local models.

kin.ollama.contextLength.description: Context window (max input tokens) advertised for Ollama models.

kin.ollama.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens advertised for Ollama models.

kin.completions.model.description: Ollama model used for inline completions. Must support fill-in-the-middle (e.g. qwen2.5-coder base variants).

kin.completions.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens generated per inline completion.

kin.completions.debounceMs.description: Delay before requesting a completion, so fast typing cancels stale requests.

kin.codebase.embeddingModel.description: Ollama embedding model used to index the codebase.

kin.codebase.chatModel.description: Ollama chat model used by the @kin codebase participant.

kin.codebase.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files indexed per workspace.
